title: Cost of Advertising - Last Updated November 2026 - Yelp

facts.fact: Yelp's advertising cost estimates are based on 812 real quotes from businesses in the United States, according to the page.
facts.quote: Based on 812 real quotes from businesses in United States.

facts.fact: Yelp's advertising cost page displays a $660 figure next to the label 'TYPICAL'; the page does not say what the other displayed amounts represent.
Yelp's advertising cost page also displays $1017 and $1700 as amounts without stating what they measure.
Yelp states that its cost estimates are calculated from real quotes and that actual costs may vary.
Yelp states that most hiring pros on its platform respond within 24 hours.
